questions.q: What should you do first when planning an audit of analytics access?
options: Turn on every log and read them all
Write down the questions you need answered, then find the source that records them
Ask users to stop using analytics
questions.explain: Audit tools only help once you know whether you need usage, performance, or change and access information.

questions.q: Which Salesforce object exposes event log files that you can query with SOQL?
questions.explain: Event Monitoring log files are exposed through the EventLogFile object, filtered by EventType.

questions.q: Which source best answers 'who changed a security setting last week'?
questions.explain: Setup Audit Trail tracks recent administrative and configuration changes; the Wave logs record analytics usage.

questions.q: What is a limitation of audit logs stated in this lesson?
options: They list every row a user saw
They record activity but not necessarily which rows a user saw
questions.explain: Logs show events such as opening a dashboard. Row-level proof relies on predicate design and testing.

questions.q: What is a common way to make usage logs useful for governance reviews?
options: Load them into the warehouse, model them, and build a usage dashboard
Store them only in a personal app
questions.explain: Modeled logs show top and unused assets and inactive users, supporting lifecycle and access reviews.
